description:
Connector packaging/install API for Weavric (#148). Parses a connector
        manifest (YAML or JSON) into a ConnectorDefinition, runs a compatibility check
        (requires.engine / requires.modules) and installs it through the connectors SDK's
        ConnectorInstaller, exposing thin admin endpoints under /admin/connectors. As a LIBRARY this
        module does NOT impose a SecurityFilterChain; instead it provides a ConnectorAdminRequestMatcher
        that the consuming app wires into its own chain and MUST guard with an admin authority.
        Connector installs are app-wide (operations register into the global definition source);
        per-tenant connector registration is deferred to the scope phase.
